headline: Woman dies after car carrying State Minister crashes in Bogra
summary: A 60-year-old woman passed away at a hospital after being hit by the vehicle of State Minister Abdul Bari while he was traveling on an official visit.
details: A 60-year-old woman named Firoza Begum died on Friday at TMSS Medical College Hospital in Bogra after being hit by a government vehicle carrying State Minister for Public Administration and Food, Abdul Bari.
The accident occurred around 9:00 AM in the Gopinathpur area of Kichak Union, Shibganj Upazila, on the Mokamtala-Joypurhat road.
According to local sources, the State Minister was traveling from Dhaka to his parliamentary constituency, Joypurhat-2, on an official visit.

The accident happened when Firoza Begum attempted to cross the highway. The driver lost control of the vehicle while trying to avoid her, causing the car to veer off the road and crash into a nearby paddy field.
Firoza Begum was seriously injured in the collision and was rushed to the hospital by locals, where she later succumbed to her injuries.
State Minister Abdul Bari and his wife, Nazma Ara Begum, who was also in the car, were injured in the crash.
The State Minister received primary medical treatment following the accident and later returned to his home.
caption:
A 60-year-old woman has died after being hit by a government vehicle carrying a State Minister in Bogra.

A 60-year-old woman named Firoza Begum died on Friday at TMSS Medical College Hospital in Bogra after being hit by a government vehicle carrying State Minister for Public Administration and Food, Abdul Bari.

The accident occurred around 9:00 AM in the Gopinathpur area of Kichak Union, Shibganj Upazila, on the Mokamtala-Joypurhat road.

According to local sources, the State Minister was traveling from Dhaka to his parliamentary constituency, Joypurhat-2, on an official visit.

The accident happened when Firoza Begum attempted to cross the highway. The driver lost control of the vehicle while trying to avoid her, causing the car to veer off the road and crash into a nearby paddy field.

Firoza Begum was seriously injured in the collision and was rushed to the hospital by locals, where she later succumbed to her injuries.

State Minister Abdul Bari and his wife, Nazma Ara Begum, who was also in the car, were injured in the crash.

The State Minister received primary medical treatment following the accident and later returned to his home.

headline_marked: Man's [[body found on Dhaka Elevated Expressway]] with mouth taped
headline: Man's body found on Dhaka Elevated Expressway with mouth taped
summary: Police suspect the man was strangled and dumped from a vehicle in the Banani area of the expressway.
details: Police recovered the body of an unidentified man, estimated to be around 50 years old, from the Dhaka Elevated Expressway on Friday morning.
The body was discovered in the Banani area, with the victim's mouth taped shut with scotch tape.
The man was wearing a blue shirt, similar to the uniform of CNG-driven auto-rickshaw drivers, and a lungi.
Banani Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Faridul Islam stated that the victim is suspected to have been strangled to death before being dumped from a vehicle.
Police are currently analyzing CCTV footage from the expressway to identify the vehicle and uncover the mystery of the death.
Authorities believe the body may have been dumped in a spot that was intentionally chosen because it was outside the coverage of the security cameras.
caption:
A man's body with his mouth taped shut was found on the Dhaka Elevated Expressway this morning.

Police recovered the body of an unidentified man, estimated to be around 50 years old, from the Dhaka Elevated Expressway on Friday morning.

The body was discovered in the Banani area, with the victim's mouth taped shut with scotch tape.

The man was wearing a blue shirt, similar to the uniform of CNG-driven auto-rickshaw drivers, and a lungi.

Banani Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Faridul Islam stated that the victim is suspected to have been strangled to death before being dumped from a vehicle.

Police are currently analyzing CCTV footage from the expressway to identify the vehicle and uncover the mystery of the death.

Authorities believe the body may have been dumped in a spot that was intentionally chosen because it was outside the coverage of the security cameras.
